text: I LOVE MY DELLA ICE MACHINE. I did what some suggested about letting it set after taking it out of the box for the refrigerant fluid to resettle properly. I have made sure there's plenty of air space around it. And everyday I get two - two gallon bags of ice. I'd probably get more but I use ice all day long. If I had a complaint it would be the basket being small. But I really can't say that I get a 32 Oz container of ice per basket full. I recommend this machine.
Great little ice maker!
I absolutely love this!!! Perfect for an apartment! Works really well, and it is not very loud while in use.
Works great!

Ordered this Ice Maker to replace a larger, older model.  After one week, it is working well and, because of its compact size, it fits much better on the kitchen counter top than the one we previously owned.  Impressed with the packaging from dealer.  The Ice Maker was double boxed and the outer box was very sturdy to protect it during shipping.

6 minutes to ice. Have to remove the ice and put in freezer, but very quick to produce decent (cubes). Actually round with a hole in the middle. We use it in our trailer and it saves buying ice or taking up valuable freezer space with ice trays. Fits nicely in the closet when not in use. Obviously can't speak to longevity yet.
Love it! Makes ice in 6 mins and keeps pumping out more! Best summer purchase ever, the kids just keep scooping it out and keeping cool.
Works grate
Makes ice quickly! I wish it had a sleeve or basket on the side to put the ice scoop in. Other than that it's a great buy

tom in west milwaukee
I have only had mine for two months and so far I love it. But one thing I did notice is that even the large size cubes seem to melt very fast

I BOUGHT THIS PRODUCT DELLA ELECTRIC ICE MAKER MACHINE,IT DID WHAT OTHER PEOPLE REVIEWED,NICE SIZE ICE,DOESN'T STICK TO ANYTHING. RELIABLE MACHINE. I USE IT EVERY TWO WEEKS WHEN I NEED IT. GREAT MACHINE,COMES IN A SECURE PACKAGE AND DELIVERED ON TIME. GREAT BUY.
Great purchase

We purchased this ice maker after the one in our freezer quit working.  Makes ice cubes fast. Really pleased with our purchase.
Fast delivery, just as describe, instructions are easy to follow and works great!

This is one great little icemaker!  Took it out of the box, washed it, filled it with water and *bam* here comes the ice!  I always make the larger size ice and have been very satisfied with the consistency.  If you're trying to make a large batch of ice, you have to stay on top of this - it stops when it's full.  Just empty it and away it goes.  I really like that there is no drain needed; the melted ice simply recycles into new ice.  I highly recommend this product!

I was surprised how quickly the ice makes, and easy it was to operate. The only bad side of this machine, it's a little noisey... but for the time I use it I can deal with it... I love the convenience of it,  and would purchase it again. Easy to clean.
Bought this ice maker less than five (5) months ago; it died!!! Company refused to replace. Caution!!!!
Had this for a while still works great glad bought it

So glad I ordered this model! Works like a charm and within a few minutes you have ice ice ice ;)

***UpDate*** So I ordered this awesome ice maker 1year and 8 months ago! This bad boy is still going strong and still makes ice super fast. I tend to be a clean freak so I deep clean it once a month. Again its a must have.
Ice cubes a little smaller than expected but perfect size for drinks. Makes ice in around 6 minutes. Quite, you can hardly hear the ice drop. I'm very satisfied with it so far.
Much smaller then we thought. It doesn't hold much ice. But it makes very quickly and we dump and store in a bin in our freezer.  It does a good job.
Loved it while it was working.  Sadly, it stoppped working less than 5 months after I bought it. Because of that, I can't recommend buying it.

I have bought three of these. One for me and two for Christmas presents. I love it and you will too!!!

works well, however color is more gun metal gray than silver

Never heard of one of these until I stumbled onto one.  Did my research.  Della came out on top, hence this purchase.  Justification was I needed a reliable supply of ice (without the ice tray hassle) for rehabilitating a joint replacement.  Works fantastic.  Turn it on, do exercises, turn off, get ice and apply to joint.  Just the right amount.  Ice within 7 minutes of "switch on".  Only paying to make what I need.  Exercising 3x/day.  21 days so far.  So, 63+ uses.  Flawless.  Makes very functional, somewhat bullet (hollow) shaped, "cubes".  They cool beverages quickly, too.  Reasonably quiet.  About the size of a bread maker.  Doesn't impose too much on counter top.  Way less expensive than adding an ice maker to a refrigerator.  Plus, for the price, if it breaks, just buy another.  No water lines.  Put it where you want the ice.  It's cool to watch, too.  Very efficient.  Am considering giving one as a wedding gift as the couple has a "dry bar".  Perfect addition.  Verrry cool item.
I would have given this five stars, except that it quit working just over a year after we purchased it. If you buy one, definitely get the warranty (which wasn't available when we got ours).
Fantastic compact ice maker. Compact footprint, nicely shaped ice cubes, very easy to use.
only had it for a few days now but it makes ice quickly and works perfectly.
Started producing ice almost immediately; very easy to set up and use.

Bought this for camping, and I am impressed with its capability.  Nine Ice cubes at a time and the first ones are done within about 5-7 min.  This is a great little ice maker and I hope to get lots of use out of it.
Loving it

DO NOT BUY. It worked for a while and then started producing giant ice chunks instead of ice cubes. After a while that issue stopped and it worked for a bit, but now it just doesn't work at all! It will only produce ice cubes the size of my pinky nail. AWFUL.

I never write reviews but I love this ice machine!  Our expensive Samsung refrigerator's ice machine consistently broke and was costing even more money to maintain.  With three kids in sports I needed ice constantly.  We bought this 6 months ago and it's been cranking out ice every day.  We keep it on our kitchen counter right next to our sink/water sprayer so we can keep it filled.  Love love love this product.  I got the silver one and it goes great with my stainless steel appliances.
I purchased this in February today it just stopped working!!!!!

I saw folks in a FB group for RV'rs talking about ice makers.  I use a lot of ice but don't have an ice maker in my refrigerator.  So I thought I'd give this a try.  I'm very impressed with it!  Love it!  It makes ice in 6 minutes and you can either dump it into a container and put the ice in your freezer or don't worry about it.  The ice will eventually melt but the machine will just freeze it into cubes again.  I bring it with me in my travel trailer so I'm never without ice even if I'm way off the beaten path.

It was a very nice gift and worked great for 3 months.  That is not long for the price.  I have cleaned it, checked the wire that is supposed to let the machine know that it has water, have tried more water and less water and, now after 3 months, it will not make ice and constantly shows the red "needs water:" light.  This was a huge disappoint and total waste of money!!  Would not give it one star, but had no choice, but to give at least one.

This stopped working slowly, which is really annoying. It worked well for a few months, then the ice cubes got smaller and smaller and now it just recycles water. Of course it's outside of the return window and the request to return has been denied - not a company that stands by their product, which is a shame.

It is A Piece shit. Only used less than 20 times then it is broke. Just save your money! If there is 0 star, I will rate below that. This is the worst products I bought online.

This product is just what I was hoping it would be. It is a little slower that I expected but the results are better than I expected. If you know you will need ice it's best to make it before doing any entertaining. One cycle yields enough ice for my wife and I that lasts about a week. We don't party like we used to. We could not easily route a water source for an automatic ice maker for the refrigerator and this unit has been an ideal solution. I like it a lot and use it regularly.

Works great - looks nice and makes lots of ice quickly.  Bought this as a alternate to replacing the one in my fridge that broke - AGAIN.  It is pretty loud and big on my counter are really my only complaints.
Performed exactly as advertised!  Very Satisfied.

You know how the "Ice Full" LED indicator light nearly blinds you when you get within five feet from this ice maker? You can prevent this by dabbing a bit of 'White Out' on the top surface of the LED light. (White Out is a tiny bottle of white paint that used to be used with typewriters, 10 years ago, to correct misspelled words ). Also, every time ice is needed you'll have to have an ice pick to break it into small pieces. But, happy with it.

Now, after operating for a couple of weeks, I have a helpful hint. I was getting ice that was thicker at the top, of the unit, than bottom. The sheet of cubes didn't drop quite right. So, I put a quarter (coin) under each of the front legs. By lifting the front a little, it changed the way the cubes were being made. It works better.

Just like others say, it works great, when it works. We got ours in January 2017 and it stopped working in October. Della's warranty makes things very difficult to have it fixed so its likely going in the junk heap. Steer clear unless you are ok with paying $100+ for something that you will need to replace every 8-10 months.
Love my ice maker! But it isn't great on a boat...cubes are a little small but does t take too long.

BOUGHT THIS FOR MY DAUGHTER, SHE LOVES IT!

Makes ice cubes fairly quickly.  It is a little bit noisy so we do have to turn it off at night.  Also ice cubes melt a lot quicker then your typical ice cubes so we find that we are using more then we would use.  Otherwise a good product for the price.

Does this machine make ice? Yes, but that's about all the positives I can say about it. The ice smells/tastes horrible - it has these chemically/plastic-like odor and taste, despite the fact that we've run several batches through, dried out the machine in between usages, etc. Also, this is my fault for not realizing beforehand, but this machine makes ice only, it does not store it. We don't have an ice maker in our refridgerator and thought this would be the solution. However, the compartment where the ice gets dumped is room temperature so the ice melts fairly quickly. You have to remember right away to dump the ice into the freezer for future use, but even still, it isn't super cold so the cubes tend to refreeze as a giant chunk. Not a fan of this machine!
This product quit working only a couple months after purchase.  I can't figure out how to get it fixed.  I contacted the seller and manufacturer and still haven't received a response how.

People always ask about it.

Hey guys, here's the truth. This machine is GREAT until it's not! Based on the reviews, the average working life of this product is about a year. I got lucky and mine died a little over a year from purchase date. It's really frustrating because now I'm back to having to shop for another ice machine and it makes me question how much I should trust the reviews. In looking at this product, there were obviously more positive than negative reviews; however, the negative reviews were DEFINITELY warranted. If you're like me, when you read the negative reviews you probably thought, "Well, something happened. Surely the machine didn't just stop." Uhmmm...yes, it did. It really just stopped! We used spring water and treated the machine with care. We're not heavy ice-eaters. We're a family of four and we probably went through a basket of ice a day. You may also be thinking, "Well maybe there's a simple fix and they just didn't troubleshoot." Yes, that was my first thought also when the machine first stopped working. I troubleshooted. I revisited the manual and the Q&A section of page. I even watched some youtube videos to make sure I wasn't missing anything. I tried cleaning the filter with a vinegar cycle and using a toothbrush to gently clean away any debris on the vent at the bottom of the tank. My point in saying all this is to save you the frustration that I am currently feeling. Notice that many of the positive reviews are not long-term reviews. I would guess that

It worked for 3 days and now the light will not go out and it will not make ice!  Customer service is non-existent. If I could give it 0 stars, I would!
Purchased this for my elderly mother who loves ice, she is very happy with the product.

Day 1 Review: Overall Pretty Good, Purchased it for my lab down here in El Paso because it gets hot a bullocks over here and it make really good ice after throwing out the first 5 batches. Ice is pretty uniform and good for chewing, I love chewing ice so this was a big deal for me, but has a pretty small specific heat capacity (1 ice cube of X area will cool your drink a smaller amount compared to other ice), but hey it was a pretty cheap solution for my problem. I am taking off one star because there are 2 glaring issues. Issue 1 is there should be a storage area outside the container to hold to scoop. Right now it is currently taking up valuable basket space for my ice. Nothing a trip to the local hardware store or 3d printing lab across the hall and some glue cant fix but still shouldnt need to do more work to manage the accessories. The second and more glaring problem is that the ice has a small and large function, which I thought would produce different diameter ice, It does not. the ice is made with a cylindrical hole in the middle and changing large to small will only increase the diameter of this hole but not the diamater of the cube itself. this leads to some less than optimal packing factors for the limited space of ice storage. Overall dont regret the purchase and it was resonably priced in comparison with other products, Would be 5 star if 20 bucks off.

I purchased the ice maker one year ago.  Sadly it stopped working within the last month.  It was not overly used as it is in my classroom. Therefore it is not in use during weekends,holidays or summer.  I would not recommend this product.

Disappointing performance.  I had to google how to “reset”, and it takes 5-10 times for it to work.  When it works it is great.  But almost every time we use it we have to spend 20-30 min. for it to work.  Bummed, because when it works it is great.
I live in a camper, and if you have ever camped, you know the freezer is tiny.  This makes ice pretty much on demand.  I love it.

Not what I expected, I wanted nugget ice & this isn’t it. Also I used it for 2 months straight & both months I had $500 electric bills, now that I’ve unplugged it my bills are back to normal

This is a great ice maker. I got it for my office. It is fairly small so works great for small spaces. It was super easy to set it up, remove tape, wipe it down, fill it water and just press the button. Within minutes the machine started to produce ice. The first round comes out really small but then the size increases as the machine continues to work. The ice is a great consistency. I like to chew ice so it is important to have chew-able ice. these cubes are soft enough to chew but hard enough that they don't melt in a drink right away.
As others have said, this is not a freezer, it is an ice-producing machine. Once the ice cubes are made, if you don't remove them, they will start to melt down. But its melts back into the water underneath the basket and can be reused for more ice cubes.

I gave 4 out of 5 starts because a couple of times, the ice cubes got suck under the mechanical arm which is supposed to left the cubes and drop them in the basket. I had to manually remove the cubes. I hope this won't continue to happen.

I would definitely suggest this product. I am VERY happy with my purchase.
almost to the day we brought it, It quit. 1 year. It should of lasted a little longer than that.  That is our second one and will not be buying any in the future. Very disappointed.

I've owned several of these ice makers and have had some problems with reliability.  When they work, they are great.  They produce chewable ice fairly quickly.  This last one I bought failed after a couple of months, but the company went out of its way to make it right by sending me a replacement at no cost to me.  If you need extra ice, these are great machines if you have some extra counter space.

My only complaint would be that it doesn't make a loud enough noise when the ice is done. It does take awhile, longer than the suggested times given, but it otherwise operates as advertised and is good for people with freezers that aren't big enough for their own ice makers.

Our ice life was in shambles before the Della machine. We had to make ice in the trays from the grocery store and they would always stick in the tray. I surprised my wife with this machine. There were a lot to choose from on amazon and I looked at the reviews from here and the review videos on youtube and settled on this model. It is great right out of the box. Follow the directions and don't plug it in right away, let the freon coolant settle for a couple hours, then plug it in.

If you have a new baby, which we do, be prepared to be freaked out by this thing. When it's low on water it makes a noise that sounds SCARILY like a baby crying in the next room. I'm 100% serious. When people come to visit and she's napping they will be like "Oop, shes awake!" and we're like, "No it's the ice machine". You'll get some sideways glances for sure.

My only beef is that it makes what I'd call "wet" ice so when it freezes in the freezer, you have to break it up before you use it each time. You don't need a sledgehammer to do it but we use a pick and it takes a little elbow grease.

The ice maker is good but hard to clean. It gets dirty easily. The first few times you only get tiny small ice cubes but once it gets going you get bigger pieces. It’s a bit loud and takes up more counter room than I thought it would.
Worked great for a while, now it doesn’t. Don’t buy this garbage.

I was pleasantly surprised by the durability and girth of the unit. It's like a real countertop appliance versus light plastic. You have to plan ahead a little as it does make cubes fast, however, in small quantities at a time. I find it's not necessarily designed for every day use where you would keep it running and making cubes all day long. It's more so to gear up for ice use for parties; exactly why I got it and it works great for that!

I really love this machine I have had it for 6 months and had no issues at all only real complaint is when I have a group of people over having to refine the water to keep it going but all and all I highly recommend this product I did a lot of research and it has lived up to all of it.

There are other reviews here that say this ice maker doesn’t last long. This is NOT the case for our household. We bought this in July of 2017 and, bless its little ice maker heart, it is still working to this day 1+ years later. We use it EVERYDAY. Ice is a staple of the household. We bought this because we were spending 5-7$ on ice a week; we have never had to buy ice again. It has two sizes of ice, but we only use the large size because it is more like a traditional ice cube. It's not quite there, but it gets a solid 80%We keep a metal bowl in the freezer with a pestle to break the ice up, as needed. 6 minutes --> 9 cubes, an hour fills the bucket. It's great! If/when this lovely saver of dollars either expires from our home or we can no longer clean it (spoiler: it’s easy to clean), we will buy this same one. Go ahead and buy it if you use ice as we do, it pays for itself!

I was diagnosed with brain cancer and the place I was living in just had a hot water heater explode. Upon further inspection it'd been leaking for awhile and mold had set into it. Going through chemo and radiation treatments it was not possible for me to live there anymore. When I moved i decided that buying bags of ice was a waste so I bought a ice maker. It lasted 2 years and paid for itself in time and money saved
I figured that was the lifespan of these contraptions so I bought this Bella. That was in 2016. No problems at all and I won't lie I treated it pretty rough. Left in on for days at a time. Only thing I did do as far as maintenance was run vinegar thru it occasionally or one of the special cleaning mixes to prevent mold or anything else. I highly recommend this machine and my life literally depended on it while I was still going through treatments. Unfortunately they failed and the tumors are at still there but my Bella ice maker was there to sooth my dry mouth or burning fever. Thank you Bella.
